meta.source: Documented from the live ganknow.com creator dashboard and public profile, 2026-10-30. Values are sampled from full-page screenshots; #FF4E58 and #38C793 are the defaults the app itself prints in Stream settings.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. The public profile swaps the near-black for the creator's navy ground.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: The fixed left sidebar and the icon rail; also page footers and the top header on public pages. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, posts, tables and settings panels sitting on bg.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: A panel inside a card: chart wells, the stream URL box, empty-state wells.

tokens.name: bg-control
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, filter chips, search buttons and the ghost button at rest.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and active rows in the sidebar, the active segmented option, secondary buttons on the profile.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between table rows and under tab strips; the sidebar's right edge is line at half strength.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg-card and bg-control. 11.9:1 on bg-card in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper copy, inactive tabs and column headers. 6.7:1 on bg-card in dark.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, chart axis labels and the eyebrow 'Pusat Kreator'. Decorative only; never for text people must read.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Gank red. The wordmark, active toggles, slider fills, the selected card border and the notification dot. The app ships #FF4E58 as its default alert colour.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Filled primary buttons on dark surfaces ('Upgrade Sekarang' in Akun, 'Upgrade Sekarang' on Boost plans). Text on it is ink-on-brand.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind brand text and the 'Baru' tag.

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand and brand-strong fills.

tokens.name: cta
tokens.usage: The filled light button used for the main action in a panel: 'Upgrade Sekarang' in the sidebar, 'Tarik Uang', 'Publish Listing', 'Kirim', 'Tip'. On the profile it becomes the periwinkle 'Lihat Halaman Tip'.

tokens.name: ink-on-cta
tokens.usage: Text on cta.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Blue callout band ('Buat target tip sekarang…') and links such as 'Hubungi kami'. Text on it is ink-on-brand.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive amounts, the 'Terverifikasi' check, leaderboard amounts (the app's default 'Warna Jumlah'). As text only on bg-card or darker.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: 'Belum Diaktifkan' dot, 'Tidak Aktif' listing status, delete actions. Never the only signal; pair with a label.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The Gank Gold coin and gold balances. Icon and numeral only.

tokens.name: overlay-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim over locked post media and behind modals.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: One family, Noto Sans from Google Fonts, in six steps. Weight does the hierarchy: 600 for titles and labels, 400 for everything that is read.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one page title at the top of a settings panel ('Dompet', 'Transaksi', 'Stream').

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a page and card titles ('Toko', 'Membership').

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, sidebar items, tab names, column headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tampilkan peringatan dengan gambar dan suara khusus ketika Kamu menerima tip.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Gunakan URL di bawah ini dalam OBS atau aplikasi streaming lainnya.
styles.usage: Helper text under inputs, timestamps, sub-labels in lists.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Sidebar group label and footer links, in ink-faint or ink-muted.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: Money and balances are set large and semibold with tabular figures.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Dashboard summary numbers; the unit follows in body at ink-muted.

groups.name: Marketing
groups.note: Boost and Creator Grant pages only.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Gali potensi penghasilan dari fanbase kamu
styles.usage: Landing-page heroes. Never inside the dashboard.

spacing.note: An 8px base. Panels are generous (32px inside), controls are tight (8–16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, dot-to-status gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips in a row; inside small tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between a label and its input; inside tab strips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of inputs and buttons; gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between form rows and between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding (the card holding a page's content).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gutter between the sidebar and the content panel, and above the first panel.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The fixed sidebar. The collapsed icon rail on public pages is 60px.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects and the primary buttons.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Sidebar items and table rows.

radius.note: Rounded but not round: panels at 16, controls at 8–12, actions as pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, the 'Baru' badge, thumbnails in lists.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, filter chips, inner panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, posts, the sidebar upgrade card.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggles, segmented controls, avatars, status pills.

shadow.note: Almost none. Depth comes from surface steps (bg → bg-card → bg-control), not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Profile cards over the navy ground; dashboard cards use none.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Dropdowns and popovers.
